clips.title: The story
paras: In the Cleft of Shadow, Cazul guides young warlocks toward greater command of demons. Blind and ancient, he remains a keeper of old orc warlock traditions.

Cazul waits in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar, where rising warlocks seek his counsel. Blind though he is, he senses the currents of the Twisting Nether and hears the whispers of demons. Those who want to master their craft and bind more dangerous servitors are often sent to him. His sight is gone, but his arcane power remains.
